scenario: [RFCS.19.5] the fields of a fact body ascend by number, one per slot, for a schema with a slot of each wire shape a fact body carries: varint (Int, Bool), 64-bit (Float), and length-delimited (String, Bytes), with a nullable String set to a value. The harness ([RCTS.1.2.19]) records one host assert of a `Packet` with every slot set and a pump, and walks the recording as `RFCS.19.5` does, after showing the walk refuses the recording with two fields of one atom body swapped. Paths: libds's recorder (`Engine.record`) and its fact-body encoder; the Mercury runtime's `ds.rfcs` `encode_stream`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Packet scope logical:
    id: String key
    seq: Int mutable
    ratio: Float mutable
    flag: Bool mutable
    payload: Bytes mutable
    tag: String? mutable

rule keep:
    Packet p where p.seq > 0
->
    log info "kept"
